claims.text: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended President Donald Trump's decision to grant a 60-day waiver from Russia-linked sanctions.
Marco Rubio stated that India has voluntarily diversified its energy portfolio but still depends substantially on Russian energy.
President Donald Trump invoked Section 115 of the Graham Act to certify that waiving sanctions was in the US national interest.
The waived Graham Act duties included tariffs of up to 500% on Russian goods and up to 100% on the five largest importers of Russian crude oil.
Donald Trump blocked several Russian sanctions on Friday night, two days before they were scheduled to take effect.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told NBC News that siding with Russian President Vladimir Putin would be a historic mistake.
Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev called Donald Trump's sanction waiver order an important and truly historic moment.
According to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air, China receives about 50% of Russia's crude exports, while India accounts for about 37%.
Donald Trump stated on Truth Social that his decision on Russia was simple and aimed at avoiding driving Russia away from peace negotiations.
Donald Trump temporarily waived sanctions on Russian diesel to allow fuel into global markets and lower prices ahead of US elections.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated he was thankful that the United States resumed intelligence sharing after a brief pause.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called President Zelensky very reckless for alleging that the US government throttled SpaceX Starlink speeds.
The US Treasury authorized a deal on October 9 for Russia to supply more than 300,000 metric tonnes of diesel to global markets.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright stated that the Russian diesel arrangement was a carrot to try to end the war rather than an economic lifeline.
A public audit of 258 households in Delhi's Okhla constituency found over 100 voters wrongly classified as absent, shifted, dead, or duplicate.
Civil society organisations including Jan Sarokar, MKSS, Voter Adhikar Manch, and NFIW held a Jan Sunwai public hearing in Batla House.
Delhi's Okhla constituency had over 67,000 names placed on the notice list and nearly 1.6 lakh on the ASDD list out of 1.85 lakh draft roll voters.
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology issued an advisory on October 10 asking Meta to review its content recommendation systems.
Apar Gupta of the Internet Freedom Foundation criticized the MeitY advisory, calling it a continuing censorship directive.
CRPF Director General GP Singh commended a female CRPF officer for demonstrating restraint after being slapped during a Cockroach Janta Party march.
Delhi Police registered three FIRs against protesters for violating prohibitory orders, conducting a flag march, and obstructing police officers.
Mumbai Police detained several people at Carter Road in Bandra who gathered for a Tiranga March called by the Cockroach Janta Party.
Protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar began following a September 23 investigation regarding Election Commissioners' objections to roll revisions.
Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke accused authorities of using delaying tactics to prolong the detention of leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka.
Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were remanded to five days of judicial custody on October 14 after scaling locked gates at Jantar Mantar.
Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited actor Tiger Shroff's residence on Sunday night following a shooting in Juhu.
Eknath Shinde stated that five rounds were fired during the incident outside a football club in Mumbai.
Tiger Shroff suffered injuries to his left hand caused by gunpowder and glass shards during the firing incident.
A video emerged featuring Anil Pandit, who claimed the Lawrence Bishnoi gang targeted Tiger Shroff for working with Salman Khan.
DCP Mohit Kumar Garg confirmed that unidentified assailants opened fire near Tiger Shroff at around 7:00 PM on Sunday evening.
Shroff's driver Firdaus sustained a hand injury, and auto-rickshaw driver Chauhan was also injured in the attack.
Gangster Anil Pandit posted that he and Harman Sandhu carried out the attack to teach Tiger Shroff a lesson.
Three rounds of gunfire were reported near actor Tiger Shroff near Pushpa Park in Juhu on Sunday evening.
Lawrence Bishnoi has been incarcerated since 2015 and is currently lodged in a Gujarat jail.
Anmol Bishnoi was arrested in California in November 2024 and deported to India in November 2025.
At least 19 people were killed and 25 were injured in a stampede at the Chorebagan Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata on Saturday evening.
West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that a Special Investigation Team headed by a sitting or retired High Court judge will probe the stampede.
The West Bengal government announced a ₹25 lakh ex-gratia payment and a Group D job for the next of kin of each deceased victim.
Police arrested seven people under charges dealing with culpable homicide not amounting to murder in connection with the stampede.
Police are examining video footage capturing a microphone warning that the Chorbagan pandal was in poor condition and might collapse.
Kolkata Police Commissioner Ajay Kumar Nand imposed Section 163 prohibitory orders on roads adjoining the pandal until October 20.
The stampede occurred at around 7:40 PM on Saturday during Saptami celebrations amid sudden rainfall.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ₹2 lakh compensation from the PMNRF for families of the deceased and ₹50,000 for each injured person.
Prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS were imposed in parts of Bowbazar until Tuesday.
West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari reported that at least 17 people were killed, including a seven-year-old girl, in the Kolkata Durga Puja crush.
Local residents in Chorebagan initiated rescue efforts and carried injured victims to cabs to reach Calcutta Medical College and Hospital.
